known_coverage_gaps: No cross-repository candidate: every pilot question is answerable within one repository or one paper-plus-repository pair; a full novel_dev should add genuinely cross-repository questions.

No version_conflict candidate: the locked corpus exposes commit-boundary conflicts already heavily represented by exposed Gold (g012/g026/g042/g058/g077/g096/g108/g120); none arose naturally for unexposed information needs during pilot curation.
No clarification_required candidate: no genuine ambiguity case was naturally supported, so the generic T0 status-compatibility check was not required and was not run.
algorithm_implementation has only one candidate (fast simulation); the locked corpus supports more (event generators, tracking), but pilot slots went to uncovered intents first.
Difficulty band is 6/8/2, one simple case above the 3-5 guidance band; the pilot kept several easy natural user questions rather than inflating difficulty labels.

recommended_coverage_targets.notes: Derived from pilot curation experience; not frozen quotas. Requires explicit user approval before becoming contract targets.

targets.version_conflict: include only when naturally supported by the locked version boundary; do not force parity with exposed Gold
naturally_supported_by_corpus: installation (fork and dependency-level setups are plentiful)
usage (documentation pages for generators, logging, event display)
api (PandaRoot tools layer is broad and mostly unexposed)
algorithm_theory (both theses contain unexposed chapters: track search/fit comparisons, alignment, KOALA)
module_structure (vendored frameworks, build variants, subsystem inventories)
evidence_scarce_in_corpus: algorithm_implementation outside the three workflow repositories' core algorithms requires code-heavy annotation effort
version_conflict cases that are not paraphrases of the exposed commit-substitution pattern

representativeness.notes: Classes are current-draft classifications for human review; dispositions direct the follow-up N1-R2 revision task. After the proposed n013 replacement (representative source_location or implementation_explanation) and n014 revision, the pilot would sit at roughly 15 representative / 1 exploratory; an exploratory cross-repository replacement for n013 would restore closer to the 12/4 guidance while also filling the cross-repository gap.
